subject: User Control of digits output in renderTable

messages.author: 70abc85dd4bcb117
messages.subject: User Control of digits output in renderTable
parts:
I found another post where Winston suggests:

renderTable passes any extra arguments along to xtable, so I think you should be able to do something like this:

renderTable({
   # Code to generate table here 
}, digits=4)

This works fine but I want to pass the result of as.numeric(input$numdec)) as the digits value. input$numdec is a selectInput box in the ui. just putting that code in, instead of the 4 seems to be completely ignored (I always get 2 decimal places no matter what the value of numdec is.  Within renderTable I am able to print the value of input$numdec and it changes as expected.  I realized that digits is passed outside of the expression that generates the table so I tried reading and setting the value for digits outside the reactive function (and also tried setting it as one of the reactiveValues but I keep getting errors about trying to perform an action that can only be done inside a reactive function.  

Thanks for any ideas,

Mike
